missables.why: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 counts toward the 18 meditation spots and disappears after that chapter. Do it in Chapter 1 and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops.

missables.risk: Time-sensitive step, not a missable trophy
missables.why: The Chapter 3 race Race Against Yago, in Yago's street racing strand, carries an hourglass icon. Do it the moment it appears and save first — the strand counts toward this trophy's 8.
There is no way to replay the final mission. Keep an untouched manual save from just before it, and one save at the start of every chapter.
Cheats are expected to switch off trophies and saving on that save. Never test cheats on your trophy save — use a throwaway save if you try them.

saveWarning: GTA 6 has no mission replay and no New Game Plus. Keep one manual save at the start of every chapter, plus one untouched save from just before the final mission. The game has 15 manual save slots plus one autosave.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

notes: Do Lucia's balcony meditation NOW — it feeds Positive Mental Attitude and disappears when Chapter 1 ends. After Lucia is home, check the kitchen in the morning (usually after the mission Down to Earth), follow her to the balcony and accept the optional task.
Beat Cal at fishing and finish an arcade game while the coast is quiet.
Save at the start of the chapter and do not overwrite it.
stages.title: Chapter 1 — Learn the ropes

notes: Daily Driver unlocks the Vice City Real Estate app — start buying the 8 garages (about $160,000 in total).
Moses opens the Scooter Bros app — start registering cars.
Rob Kingpin Bowling with Sticky Bombs for Let's Go Bowling; take all three valuables.
Sample every activity type once for Master of None.
stages.title: Chapter 2 — Two protagonists

notes: Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun — rob a jewelry store undetected for Sneakthief.
Rob 3 shops back to back with your partner for Retail Therapy; never let the wanted level drop.
Do Race Against Yago the moment it appears (hourglass icon) — it is time-sensitive and its strand counts toward Strangers & Freaks. Save first.
stages.title: Chapter 3 — The crew comes together

notes: Run the optional mission That's Where The Money Is to open bank vaults — 5 vaults for Maximum Withdrawal, and escaping one with your partner pops Hot Together.
Rob an armored truck for A Classic Blitz Play; rob one illegal operation per gang for Pest Control.
stages.title: Chapter 4 — Big scores

notes: Keep one untouched manual save from just before the final mission. There is no mission replay.
After the credits, everything outside the story stays available: side-story finales, collectibles and the 100% checklist.
stages.title: The final mission

notes: Finish the six side-story finales (Kenton, Billy, Andy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret) — all stay open after the credits.
Sweep collectibles region by region: 3 card sets, 100 WAiNK locations, 100 vehicles (scan with WAiNK), full map coverage.
Grinds for the 100% checklist: 300 stunts, 70 of 80 Challenges, 42 Shooting Range golds, 14 Top Fun drone race wins, 8 bank vaults, 39 illegal operations.
Five trophies have no confirmed method at launch (In The Beginning…, Capital Offense, Bad Luck, I Guess, The Truth Is Out There, Ten Pin) — check their guides for the latest word.
stages.title: Post-story cleanup

notes: Open the 100% checklist under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and clear its 35 tasks.
A Long Road (Gold) pops at 100% — and Vice Got a Price! (Platinum) pops right after it, since it is the last of the 54.
stages.title: 100% and the Platinum

subtitle: 55 trophies · 1 Platinum · 2 Gold · 6 Silver · 46 Bronze · about 200 hours. Every trophy is single-player and offline; there are no online trophies. Built from the official trophy descriptions.
title: Roadmap to the Platinum
